# Session Retrospective

When asked to capture a session retro, end-of-session learnings, or /retro:
Apply the workflow from `projects/EnzymeFinder/.claude/skills/capturing-retro/SKILL.md`.

Trigger phrases: "/retro", "session retro", "capture learnings", "end of session", "what did we learn"

Key rules:
- Output to: `/projectnb/liu-scc/philipp/memories/session/retro-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md`
- Use the exact 5-section schema: Summary, Decisions Made, New Patterns, Issues to Create, Memory Update Proposals.
- Memory update proposals must be before/after diffs, NOT prose.
- Do NOT propose updates to root DECISIONS.md, AGENTS.md, or ARCHITECTURE.md — those require Context Engineer PR.
